verdict.line: You lose if you let Shen poke freely and force him to all-in you into Feint; you win if you make lane a skirmish he has to answer with Shadow Dash on cooldown.

brief.thesis: This is a 46.5% matchup over 1378 games despite Camille's 50.8% baseline, which means Shen's kit answers Camille's specific tools: Feint (W) is a flat damage shield that can eat an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto for free, and Shadow Dash (E) taunts through your own engage timing. The matchup is decided by who baits whose cooldown first, not by raw stats.

theirWindow.when: Shadow Dash (E) is up, you're overextended
theirWindow.what: Shen can dash in from 575 range, taunt you on contact, and follow with Vorpal Blade (Q) life-tap heals. Back off wave or hug minions so the dash either whiffs or he eats minion aggro instead.

yourWindow.when: Shen's E and W are both down
yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Use E (Hookshot) off a sidelane wall to engage, then land the delayed-recast Precision Protocol (Q) for the big second hit since he has no shield to absorb it and no taunt to punish your dash-in.

start.why: 46.3% win rate over 1107 games and the overwhelming 69.8% pick; the lifesteal and AD let you win extended trades where Shen's Vorpal Blade is also sustaining him, so you need your own damage-to-heal ratio to keep pace.

boots.why: 52.6% pick rate at 45.9% win; Shen's Ki Strike empowered autos and Vorpal Blade are both physical, so the flat reduction on his auto-reset trades matters more than magic resist.

core.why: 39.7% pick in the top build path at 53.4% win; the move speed and empowered auto proc both synergize with Q's bonus movement to close distance before Shen can set up Feint.

lane is going even and you want faster ultimate and ability cooldowns to out-skirmish him before he hits 6

runes.keystoneWhy: 44.7% pick rate and the top-performing page; sustained health regen directly offsets Shen's poke-and-shield pattern and rewards you for staying in minion-trade range rather than backing off.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the top pick at 28.9% with the best win rate at 48.7%; Teleport lets you reset after even trades and still contribute to sidelane skirmishes where this matchup is actually decided.

playing.title: Bait Feint before all-in
playing.detail: Throw a cheap poke or minion-trade auto to force Shen to pop Feint (W) early. Once it's down, your empowered Q auto goes through clean.

playing.title: Track Shadow Dash range
playing.detail: Shen's E has 575 range and taunts on contact. Stay outside that threat radius when you don't want to be locked down, especially before trading.

playing.title: Hookshot off sidelane walls
playing.detail: Use E (Hookshot) proactively to reposition for all-ins rather than reactively; it has an 800 range but needs a wall, so plan your engage angle before the fight starts.

playing.title: Delay your Q recast
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's second hit does significantly more damage if you wait between the two attacks. Land the first auto, then bait Shen into committing before you recast.

playing.title: Punish his Q cooldown dips
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade is only 4-6s cooldown depending on rank, so Shen can spam it in trades. Watch for him missing a cast and burst him in that window before it's back up.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Stand United
playing.detail: His ultimate has a 25000 range global teleport-shield; don't force skirmishes elsewhere on the map expecting him to be stuck in lane.

playing.title: Use W heal to win attrition
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep's outer-cone slow and bonus damage also heals you; landing it in extended trades directly counters his Q life-tap sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells here are pulled from measured OP.GG data on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reasoning connecting them to Shen's kit is my own read, not sourced from the win-rate data itself.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of getting caught with Shen’s taunt! Be careful of having [Q] blocked when Shen’s (W) is active! Camille will have an easy time contesting lane if she uses her passive [P] to engage.
